task: Compute exact-source-bound GE06/GE07/Lambda/Y-zero-gradient homogeneous background Euler E_i00 on the same frozen Repair13 C_min/C_star/C_max x Nt128/Nt64 physical grids. Save both original FD4 and FD8 physical-time numerical Euler divergences, exact scalar/dust currents and nonzero GE06 shift background momentum. Do not assume E00=0 based on background Friedmann alone.

strict_physical_definition.original_GE06_action: Exact frozen GE06 plane-symmetric GR+AeST local partial_map, evaluated at N=1,L=R=a,b=u=0,Lt=Rt=a*H,pt=Q0+Z0*Z_action, all spatial gradients and other time jets=0. Use symbolic stable Z substitution PRIOR to numerical lambdification, not cancellation-prone floating Q-Q0.
strict_physical_definition.original_GE07_action: Exact frozen GE07 L_d=NLR^2*rho*(W^2-V^2-1) evaluated at rho=3*C/a^3,Tt=1,Tx=0. Background J_Tt=2*a^3*rho=6*C and rho constraint=0; do not introduce rho multiplier to E_rho.
strict_physical_definition.original_Lambda: Exact -6*rho_lambda_action*N*L*R^2 with rho_lambda_action from same Repair13 parent, even if its grid variation is numerically nonzero. Exact background EN=-6*rho_lambda*a^3, EL=-6*rho_lambda*a^2, ER=-12*rho_lambda*a^2.
strict_physical_definition.original_NL0C_Y: Y background derivative at X0=0 from frozen d8 restricted zero-gradient symbolic gate is zero. Mixed nonlinear Y2/DY2 and actual GE05 bath are not evaluated in this stage.
strict_physical_definition.spatial_homogeneous_derivative: Analytically partial_chi of background action coefficients vanishes; retain nonzero original background b_x momentum p_bx00 as a physical archive array. Do not numerically convert xi=ln(a) to chi.
strict_physical_definition.freeze_formula: EN=GE06_Nf00+GE07_Nf00+Lambda_Nf00; EL=GE06_Lf00-H*FDxi GE06_Lt00+GE07_Lf00+Lambda_Lf00; ER analogous; Eb=GE06_bf00+GE07_bf00; Eu=GE06_uf00-H*FDxi GE06_ut00; Ephi=-H*FDxi GE06_phi_t00; ET=-H*FDxi GE07_T_t00; Erho=GE07_rho_f00.
strict_physical_definition.source_bound_closed_forms: Audit all frozen GE06 partial_map on homogeneous background against independently derived N_f=6*a*adot^2+2*a^3*(K-Q*KQ), L_f=-2*adot^2+2*a^2*K, R_f=2*L_f, L_t=-4*a*adot, R_t=-8*a*adot, b_x=4*a^2*adot, phi_t=2*a^3*KQ, remaining local partials 0, with K=2*K2*Z0^2*(exp(Z^2)-1), KQ=4*K2*Z0*Z*exp(Z^2), Q=Q0+Z0*Z. Compare source GE07 exact partial_map to its independent exact homogeneous expressions.
strict_physical_definition.exact_background_identity: EN/(6*a^3)=H^2-(Q*KQ-K)/3-C/a^3-rho_lambda. Scalar conservation a^3*KQ=frozen I0. Do not impose EL=0 when rho_lambda grid derivatives have not been independently bounded.

preregistered_machine_only_controls.source_symbolic_formula_equivalence: Exact sympy identity equality required for each frozen GE06/GE07 action local partial. No relative acceptance of an incorrect action.
preregistered_machine_only_controls.note: The 1e-12 comparison is ONLY numeric evaluation consistency between already symbolically proven identical original-action partials. It is not an Euler on-shell, H4 Ward or temporal convergence tolerance.
